objects.description: A black altar supports the Barrow Crown. The dead monarchs stand around it in silent judgment.

components.label: Choose the Crown's Fate
components.tooltip: Decide whether to destroy or claim the Barrow Crown. This choice changes the final Barrow Crown dungeon.
components.prompt: The Barrow Crown waits on a black altar. The dead kings and queens do not move, but every hollow eye follows the living. What will the party do?

goal.text: Choose the fate of the Barrow Crown.

intro.text:
The Silent Cathedral has shown where the crown was carried: lower than the tombs, past the drowned bones, beneath the old royal chapel itself. Lady Yseld walks with one hand wrapped in linen, hiding the blood-mark that opened the way this far.

The stair into the sixth barrow is not a stair for mourners. It is a procession route for dead kings. Every wall bears kneeling figures, every lintel carries a crown scratched out by frightened hands, and every door seems built to keep something royal from remembering it was ever dead.

Sister Maelis lifts her lantern and whispers, "If the Barrow Crown is truly below, do not treat it like treasure. It is a command waiting for a head."

Far ahead, beyond the maze of crypts and unholy chapels, something vast unlocks itself once, then falls silent.

outro.text: The Barrow Crown waits for judgment on the black altar.

storyTriggers.title: The Crown Vault Opens
storyTriggers.text:
Before you stands a vault door large enough for a giant, engraved with every ruler of the forgotten dynasty. All of them are shown kneeling before the first king.
In the center of the door is a crown-shaped hollow.
Lady Yseld touches the stone. The door recognizes her blood.
With a sound like a mountain exhaling, the Crown Vault opens.
Beyond it lies not a simple treasure chamber, but an entire buried palace of gold, dust, and sealed judgment.
At its heart, on a black altar, rests the Barrow Crown.
And around it stand the dead kings and queens who wore it after their deaths.

storyTriggers.title: The Skeleton Faction Breaks
storyTriggers.text: The Ossuary Warden collapses into armor, bones, and old command. Along the crypt walls, skeletal soldiers lower their weapons as if a captain has finally stopped giving orders.

storyTriggers.title: The Rot Crown Falls
storyTriggers.text: The Rot-Crowned Ghoul dies clutching at an invisible coronet. The smell of wet graves recedes, and the corpse-things left behind seem less like an army and more like abandoned meat.

storyTriggers.title: The Locked Door Opens
storyTriggers.text: The Wraith of the Crown Door breaks apart into ash and whispers. Somewhere deeper in the crypt, a lock accepts that its keeper has failed.
